mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates labor market weakness that signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105), the market anticipates overheating and policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when PAYEMS grows, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% indicates persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and GDP growth signal a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100 indicates severe economic contraction, prompting policy stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate intervention.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
